design.name: 鲲鹏·鹏形态
design.brief: Chapter boss Kun-Peng (鲲鹏) of the Zhuangzi, SECOND form: the great fish Kun has changed into the giant bird Peng, 'whose back is thousands of li across and whose wings are like clouds hanging from the sky'. A colossal sea-eagle-like bird that still shows its fish origin: the same blunt armoured head and wise ancient eyes glowing aqua-cyan as the Kun, a hooked beak lined with ice-tusk teeth, long whisker barbels trailing from the beak, ink-blue scales on the neck and chest turning into huge frost-edged feathers, two vast wings, a fan of long tail feathers like fish fins, big talons; the same glowing aqua-cyan pearl in its forehead (weak spot). Majestic and world-ending.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert roster (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges, ice as a few big faceted shapes, scales and fins as big simple carved shapes. Show the whole bird in flight with wings spread.
